title: EventBus self-unregister + double-unregister + re-register recovery contract

contract.self_unregister: A callback can unregister itself during an active EventBus.emit() cycle
contract.double_unregister_idempotency: A second unregister attempt for an already removed callback returns false without corrupting the registry
contract.reregister_after_unregister: The same owner can re-register after self-unregister
contract.current_cycle_continuity: The active callback receives the current broadcast exactly once
contract.current_cycle_reregister_isolation: The re-registered callback does not receive the active broadcast a second time
contract.single_owner_entry: Exactly one listener entry exists for the owner after recovery
contract.registry_order_integrity: The self-removed and re-registered owner is restored at the end of the registry
contract.post_recovery_delivery_once: Subsequent broadcasts deliver exactly once to every registered listener
contract.emit_continuity: EventBus.emit() remains successful before and after recovery
contract.source_metadata: Delivered events preserve the plugin_id supplied to emit() as source metadata
contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus registration, unregister, and emit operations require the events permission
